title: 第7章 她要流鼻血了
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
路雪鸢只想着女儿平安，没有想到这一层，“那至少也得带一小队护卫进去，或者带上几个你的炉鼎，不然，母亲不放心。”

    路仙瑶作为一名资深的小说爱好者，像苍山这种副本设计一般不会那么简单。

    这位红月上仙留下一道如此强大的领域，至今无人能破，且时隔百年开启一次，定是想引人进去继承她的衣钵。

    又或是留下什么线索，让后人去寻找，届时避免不了一番明争暗斗。

    她一个人前去，肯定不行，毕竟想要杀人夺宝的人也很多，但带太多人也不可，就按母亲说的，带一小队护卫低调前去即可。

    再挑两个炉鼎陪着，要是遇险，他们负责抗伤害。

    她点头，“好。”

    如此，路雪鸢便放心了。

    她从自己的储物锦囊里摸出一把圆扇，扇边乃特殊金属而制，镶嵌着华丽的珠宝，整面扇子看上去华贵不已。

    “这是华光镜，可望穿一切壁垒，红月上仙的府邸必定会隐藏在肉眼不可见的地方，透过此镜可找到她的府邸。”

    这不就是透视镜吗？

    好东西啊！

    路仙瑶毫不犹豫收下，“谢谢母亲。”

    路雪鸢又摸出一只翠玉手镯，说道：“瑶瑶，苍山里面危险重重，我这有一份苍山的图纸，其中详细标注了几个较为危险的区域，可助你避开危险。”

    轻轻一碰，便有苍山的图纸投影而出。

    探险最不能缺少的便是地图了！

    路仙瑶同样的毫不犹豫收下，为母亲为自己准备那么多东西而感动，“谢谢母亲，你就是这世上最好的母亲！”

    “傻孩子，哪有母亲不爱自己孩子的？”路雪鸢摸摸她脑袋。

    她见路仙瑶这番改变，难免好奇，问道：“瑶瑶，你是不是为了追随那云鹤绝，才想着努力修炼的？”

    也不怪母亲有这想法，因为原主懒散惯了，每次改变都是为了云鹤绝。

    路仙瑶认真地说道：“母亲，女儿这些日子认真想过了，男人嘛，多的是，一个不行，不还是有您给我找的九个吗？就算天下儿郎不愿与我在一起，那我也不能因为没男人要，便不修炼了。”

    “再说了，天行健，君子以自强不息，您都能修炼至圣道期，那我身为您的女儿，更不能给你丢脸啦！”

    路雪鸢看着她眼中坚定的眼神，确实能感受到她的改变仅仅是为了她自己，而不是为了云鹤绝。

    这让她更欣慰了。

    她不由得摸摸路仙瑶的脑袋，“很好，不愧是我路雪鸢的女儿！”

    路仙瑶也顺势依靠在她怀里撒娇。

    又聊了一会儿，送母亲离开后，路仙瑶让人去把九个炉鼎叫来自己的寝殿。
content_en:
Lu Xueyuan only thought about her daughter's safety and did not think about this aspect. "Then you must at least bring a small team of guards in, or bring a few of your furnaces. Otherwise, mother will not worry."

    As Lu Xianyao is a senior novel lover, the design of a copy like Cangshan is generally not that simple.

    The Red Moon Immortal left such a powerful realm that no one can break yet. She opened it once every hundred years. She must be trying to attract people to inherit her mantle.

    Or maybe there are some clues left for future generations to find, which will inevitably lead to some open and covert fights.

    It's definitely not possible for her to go alone. After all, there are many people who want to kill people and seize treasures, but she can't bring too many people. Just follow her mother's instructions and go low-key with a small team of guards.

    Pick two more cauldrons to accompany you. If you are in danger, they will be responsible for resisting damage.

    She nodded, "Okay."

    In this way, Lu Xueyuan felt relieved.

    She took out a round fan from her storage bag. The edge of the fan was made of special metal and inlaid with gorgeous jewelry. The entire fan looked extremely luxurious.

    "This is the Huaguang Mirror, which can see through all barriers. The Red Moon Immortal's mansion must be hidden in a place invisible to the naked eye. Her mansion can be found through this mirror."

    Isn't this a perspective mirror?

    What a good thing!

    Lu Xianyao accepted it without hesitation, "Thank you, mother."

    Lu Xueyuan took out another jade bracelet and said: "Yao Yao, there are many dangers in Cangshan Mountain. I have a drawing of Cangshan Mountain, which has detailed markings on several more dangerous areas to help you avoid danger."

    With a slight touch, a drawing of Cangshan is projected out.

    The most indispensable thing for adventure is a map!

    Lu Xianyao accepted it without hesitation, and was touched that her mother had prepared so many things for her, "Thank you, mother, you are the best mother in the world!"

    "Silly child, how can a mother not love her child?" Lu Xueyuan touched her head.

    Seeing Lu Xianyao's change, she was inevitably curious and asked, "Yao Yao, are you trying to practice hard just to follow Yun He Jue?"

    It's not surprising that my mother had this idea, because the original owner was used to being lazy, and every change was for Yun Hejue's sake.

    Lu Xianyao said seriously: "Mother, my daughter has thought about it seriously these days. There are too many men. If one is not enough, don't you still have the nine you found for me? Even if the men in the world don't want to be with me, then I can't stop practicing just because I don't have a man."

    "Besides, Tian Xing is vigorous and a gentleman strives to constantly strive for self-improvement. If you can cultivate to the stage of the Holy Path, then as your daughter, I cannot embarrass you!"

    Lu Xueyuan looked at the firm look in her eyes and could really feel that her change was only for herself, not for Yun Hejue.

    This made her even more relieved.

    She couldn't help but touch Lu Xianyao's head, "Very good, she is indeed my Lu Xueyuan's daughter!"

    Lu Xianyao also took advantage of the situation and leaned on her arms to act coquettishly.

    After chatting for a while and sending his mother away, Lu Xianyao asked someone to call the nine furnace tripods to his dormitory.
